opinions.text:
C. A. 9th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 522 U. S. 1024.] Motion of respondent to permit Ad Hoe Telecommunications Users Committee et al. to present argument as amici curiae denied.

Justice O’Connor took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
